title: Ya Imam e Raza Aye shahenshahe
body:
Ya Imam-e-raza, ya Imam-e-raza, Aye shahenshahe khurasaan, Ya Imam-e-raza, Aye imam-e-Raza Salam-o-alaik.
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekasi keh rahi hai mayyat per, warise karbala salam-o-alaik.
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Ho raha hai fiza me gham mehsoos, bujh gaya aftab-e-shehre toos, Aasmano se aa rahi hai sada, nayab-e-mustafa Salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Chha rahi hai udasiyan hersoon, aur tapakte hain aankh se aasoo, Sari duniya me ek talatum hai, deen ke nakhuda salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Qalbe kaunain para para hai, tumko zehre dagha se mara hai, Aye ghareebul watan salam-o-alaik, Aye aseere jafa salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
4- Shahe aali muqam ka taboot, uth raha hai imam ka taboot, Apna sar peet ker janaze per, keh rahi hai qaza salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
5- Maut per aapki imam-e-mubin, keh rahe hain ghareeb aur miskeen, Ho gaye aaj besahara hum, kul ke hajat rawa salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
6- Utra utra hai raat ka chehra, zard hai kayenaat ka chehra, Zeher ki kaifiyat hai saanso me, tajdare wafa salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
7- Kaisa ranjo malal ka din hai, noor ke inteqal ka din hai, Aaj dil ki hare k dhadkan se, aa rahi hai sada salam-o-alaik..!!
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
<<DIVIDER>>
8- Mere maula qubool farmana, leke kuch aasuon ka nazrana, Pursa dete hain aamir-o-akhter, naazishe ambiya salam-o-alaik.
<<MINI>>
Shore matam hai Sogwaron me, aye Imam-e-raza salam-o-alaik *2
